title: Trump Faces REVOLT By Own UFO Team? White House Aide ROASTS POTUS With 'Aliens Don't Care' Jab
description: What if aliens arrived on Earth while Donald Trump was president—and simply didn’t care who occupied the White House? Trump’s UFO disclosure push has put unidentified anomalous phenomena back in the spotlight, but now his own UAP adviser, Harvard physicist Avi Loeb, has delivered a striking twist. Loeb says an extraterrestrial visitor from interstellar space would likely have little interest in America, human borders, or the identity of the U.S. president. Yet he argues that if humanity discovered we are not alone during Trump’s presidency, the historic moment could define Trump’s legacy for millions of years.
